name: Ms. Hisako's Magical Clinic
source:
Hisako is a magical girl nurse! Hisako can heal anything, everyone, with a small sacrifice from her, of course. After all, everything comes at a price. But, it’s a small cost, compared to saving lives, isn't it?
To heal, an equal price will be paid. A leg for a rib, a patient's peace for your most tender memory. How far will you go? Or, how far can you go, until there is nothing left?

[From [url=https://imsphynx.itch.io/ms-hisakos]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
久子是魔法少女护士！久子可以治愈任何事情、每个人，当然，她需要做出一点小小的牺牲。毕竟，一切都是有代价的。但是，与拯救生命相比，这只是一个很小的成本，不是吗？
为了治愈，将付出同等的代价。用一条腿换一根肋骨，用病人的安宁换取你最温柔的记忆。你会走多远？或者，你能走多远，直到一无所有？

[来自[url=https://imsphynx.itch.io/ms-hisakos]itch.io[/url]]
